senses.gloss: mīḍha, m. (= Pali mīḷha; cf. also prec.), dung: Mvy 〔6966〕; mahato (mss. mahānto) mīḍha-parvatasya upariṃ Mv 〔ii.137.11〕; mīḍhaṃgirī LV 〔197.3〕, mountains of dung; varjeti kāmāṃ yatha mīḍha-kumbhaṃ Mv 〔ii.377.21〕 (vs), like a pot of dung; this is a favorite comparison, esp. with mīḍha-ghaṭa, LV 〔173.20〕; 〔174.3〕; 〔213.5〕; RP 〔19.9〕 (vs; text ˚ghatāṃ, read ˚ghaṭāṃ, acc. pl.); mīḍha-viṣayā(ḥ) LV 〔127.18〕; mīḍhāvaliptaḥ Śikṣ 〔173.8〕.
